narratives.Overview:
## Bound contract (lean 5501665011)

1. Fail-close `triage:classify --mirror` itself, **including dry-run**, with a pointer at #4070. Fail-closing only `--apply` is not enough (portfolio-priority Phase 1, welcome tip, commands.md still run classify).
2. Do not treat `skipped_disabled` as the off-switch. Apply refuses even when `enabled` is still true. Both default sites (`label-mirror.ts` and `policy/index.ts`) are hygiene, not the guarantee.
3. Keep a withdrawn stub on the **same pack triggers**. Do not delete the pack entry. Recut always-pin work-selection (`AGENTS.md` / `agents-entry.md`, #1309) and refinement Phase 0 to: `plan-sequence:current`, then a read-only `triage:queue` listing. `packs:slice` alone is not the off-switch.
4. Strip chips via remaining-set label apply, not through classify. Leave `candidates.jsonl` and queue grouping alone. Population is essentially `triaged` and `triage:deferred` (plus four `needs-human`); `archived` and `lifecycle-linked` have zero carriers.
5. Restate the harm: first-match is true; regex is not. Predicates are labels / body-text / state / age-days. Universal hold-marker defer runs first and can shadow consumer escalate. **Before the strip**, emit the existing `--json` digest so #4071 can see shadowed versus faithful chips.
6. Name #3579 as transitively withdrawn for the gap. Do **not** close #1423, #3579, #2611, or #3923. Leave design-critique catalog chips. Leave ingest / `triage:accept`.

## Harm restatement

`triaged` and `triage:*` chips promise the issue was triaged. They are first-match classify output over labels / body-text / state / age-days, not regex. Universal hold-marker defer (`UNIVERSAL_RULES[0]`) runs first and can shadow consumer escalate. None of the 23 issues that completed a design-critique arc also carry `triaged`.

## As-filed AC still required

Skill stub; packs:slice by those triggers does not load the old playbook. `triage:classify -- --mirror --apply` (and dry-run) exits non-zero with pointer to #4070. Mirror discovery tip does not fire. Zero issues on deftai/directive carry `triaged` or `triage:deferred|archived|lifecycle-linked|needs-human`. Arc chips unchanged. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] names the withdrawal and the strip. #3124 discovery and #1423 Wave 1-2 apply are unusable after this lands, without closing those issues from this PR.

## Non-goals

New sieve (#4071). Deleting GitHub label definitions. Changing ingest / design-critique contract. Closing #1423, #3579, #2611, or #3923.
